  PROBLEM: The Python extraction relies on limited regex patterns, so a template-owned helper added through another mechanism could be omitted from the extracted set and pass the guard unblocked.

  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]

  WHY: A malformed implement.yml or missing staging block causes extraction to fail silently, leaving FETCHED_SCRIPTS_IGNORE_FILE empty and falling back to blanket scripts/ rejection, which would incorrectly block consumer-owned scripts; moonshotai_kimi-k3 verified the fallback as deliberate fail-closed behavior.

  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]

  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The tree carries two changelog.d fragments announcing the same user-facing fix, while 3883 describes an implementation superseded by this merge.
  WHY: scripts/assemble_changelog.py folds every fragment into CHANGELOG.md without deduplication, so both entries would be published with stale, contradictory implementation descriptions.
